unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፫ — Meraf 3: Grand Master of ሠ and ረ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ሠ and ረ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የሠ እና የረ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: SEREGELA
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'SEREGELA' (Chariot) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ሠረገላ
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Chariot' (Seregela). Find the correct missing first letter: [ ? ]ረገላ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ሠረገላ (pronounced Se-re-ge-la).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 1st form ➔ 3rd form ➔ 5th form ➔ [ ? ] (7th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ረግረግ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Wetland (Regreg)!

games.title: Grand Decoder: REGREG
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'REGREG' (Wetland) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ሥ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the native 6th form 'Ss' sound of the ሠ family. Which symbol matches this silent form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ራስ
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Head or Self (Ras)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 4th form 'ራ', followed by 6th form 'ስ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: RAS
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'RAS' (Head) with the correct Amharic word.
